# Presenting Twig information

Use after the [Twig foundation](../SKILL.md). Presentation changes neither
observations nor mutation authority.

## Destination

Use verified host capabilities for links, Markdown, ANSI, width and interaction.
Do not infer them from a provider name. Honor applicable scoped preferences only
through an established lookup mechanism. Without verified rich support, use
deliberate plain text; do not install adapters or rewrite host settings.

Generic skill installation can target different hosts; this does not ship an
OMP presenter or Copilot item companion. The retired TUI/Herdr/OMP adapters and
captured CLI UI envelopes are not alternate presentation routes. Current daemon
MCP and the independent canvas package have their own bounded contracts.

## Facts and review

- Name exact work-item type/identity first and preserve actual status wording.
- Keep hierarchy, dependency and Related relationships distinct.
- Label cached, partial, unavailable, inferred and proposed information.
- Escape untrusted work-item content for the destination.
- For proposals use the exact proposal plus complete
  `proposal preview --file <path> -o json` output;
  never parse colored terminal text or assume an old `reviewModel`/presentation
  envelope.
- Preserve every material effect, precondition and blocker together with the
  exact digest and workspace. Do not replace missing evidence with empty values.

The CLI supplies static human rendering and structured data. RenderTree is a
public rendering SDK, not a provider, approval system or publisher. A displayed
proposal is not applied; apply still requires native digest confirmation and
verified journal/readback outcomes.
